NO pointer/arrow/spike in this panel: pointer will be a separate asset. No text, no icon, no separator, no portrait, no circles, no glow clouds, no background. Real alpha transparency ONLY outside panel silhouette at corners and small 2% surrounding margin. Similar modest gold-bordered tooltip to reference, NOT thick ornate picture frame. Asset fills most of square canvas.

Flat front-facing UI texture, no perspective, no arrow shaft. One centered triangle, no surrounding panel, no text, no icon, no shadows, no glow. Genuine transparent background all around shape.
